an1.51:1.1: “Radiant” (_pabhassara_) is a standard description of the mind in absorption ([mn140:20.3](), [sn46.33:2.1](), [an3.102:1.6](), [an5.23:2.5]()).
an1.51:1.4: [mn36]() details how the Buddha practiced “development of the mind” through the four absorptions to realize awakening. The topic is further discussed in relation to radiance and corruption in [mn127]().
